title: Starlight Glass Core Essential
shortDescription: React components for interfaces where actions, state and evidence stay clear.
description: Build an AI product interface with 19 typed React components, three semantic themes and 24 original utility icons. Use opaque reading surfaces with optional glass context. Inspect versioned component contracts before coding-agent changes. Essential provides the compiled package and editable component source for your own React application; Professional adds the independent Next.js starter.
